channel.title: wardlab: result archives and methodology changes
channel.description: New result archives, data corrections and methodology changes. Same content as the website; read only, not investment advice.

item.title: Result archive: October BOJ rate decision
item.description: “No change” resolved Yes. Quotes at fixed points before the release, the platform's resolution record and the official schedule (planned).

item.title: Result archive: October FOMC rate decision
item.description: “No change” resolved Yes. Quotes at fixed points before the release, the platform's resolution record and the official schedule (planned).

item.title: Methodology change: New topic page “Central banks and rates”: next Federal Reser
item.description: New topic page “Central banks and rates”: next Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan meetings, current pricing, a Polymarket–Kalshi comparison, archives and reviews of resolved meetings, and readings. It uses only events already public, with the same figures as the board.

item.title: Methodology change: Resolved events with a registered official schedule (startin
item.description: Resolved events with a registered official schedule (starting with the October FOMC and Bank of Japan meetings) now have a review page with five fixed parts: the event and its rules, evidence before the release (from the result archive), the platform's resolution record, data limitations, and what the record can show. Reviews are generated from the archive by a program; they do not judge whether forecasts were right or interpret official releases.

item.title: Methodology change: Result archives are now saved when first generated and no lo
item.description: Result archives are now saved when first generated and no longer change with restarts or data cleanup; if the platform resolution or the official calendar is corrected, a new version is saved and listed under data corrections. Archive points are separated: the “before scheduled release” columns show pricing before the release, while the “last valid quote before platform resolution” may come after the release and is marked as such; the official column is now “Official schedule (planned)”. Every historical value now comes from a single quote record, never a bid and an ask from different times; resolved events no longer show a quality computed from today's order book. Platform trading closes in the calendar now run 75 days ahead like official dates; the Today page adds a data status line and “After a move: what to read next”.

item.title: Methodology change: We now record each event's data quality once an hour; result
item.description: We now record each event's data quality once an hour; result archives show the quality recorded at each point, and points before recording began say “not kept at the time” rather than reconstructing it. Each resolved public event has a permanent archive page, listed in an archive index; the page stays available after the event leaves the board.

item.title: Methodology change: Event charts now carry a timeline: registered official sched
item.description: Event charts now carry a timeline: registered official schedule items, rule version changes, data-quality level changes, platform resolutions, and “shifts” (our own hourly mid moving at least 3 percentage points from the previous stable level and staying on the same side an hour later; one-off jumps do not count). The Today page's “what to watch after a move” uses the same result. These marks show what happened at the same time, not why the price moved.

item.title: Methodology change: The calendar now includes the U.S
item.description: The calendar now includes the U.S. midterm election day (November 3, calculated from federal law), linked to the House, Senate and balance-of-power events; polls close at different times in each state, so it is listed by date only, with no exact countdown.

item.title: Methodology change: The board's data status now judges each source as normal, de
item.description: The board's data status now judges each source as normal, delayed or unknown against its own check interval (order books every 5 minutes, the rest hourly). When a version has not been updated for more than 45 minutes, it says the version is out of date rather than implying the sources are fine. When the bid and ask have matched every check for a long time, it says the resting orders have not moved, not that the market has not changed.

item.title: Methodology change: For multi-outcome events, “Usable” now states that only the
item.description: For multi-outcome events, “Usable” now states that only the main outcome is judged, and event rows show how many outcomes are quoted; unquoted outcomes are no longer counted as 0% in distribution charts, which are rescaled over the quoted outcomes only.

item.title: Methodology change: Resolved events now open with “Result and resolution”: it st
item.description: Resolved events now open with “Result and resolution”: it states that the platform resolved the market and that we have not separately checked the official announcement, and no longer shows a close countdown, price sensitivity or confidence. Official items with no announced time are shown by date only and count as passed only after that day ends. The homepage summary is tiered into usable, weak-evidence and not-usable events, and not-usable moves are left out of any statement about direction; when some outcomes lack two-sided quotes, readings compare only the quoted outcomes. Added a reading guide, an upcoming calendar and result archives for resolved events.

item.title: Methodology change: The biggest-moves lists on the homepage, board and daily bri
item.description: The biggest-moves lists on the homepage, board and daily brief now follow one rule: usable events that moved at least 1 pp in 24 hours, with weak-evidence events listed separately and unusable or resolved events left out; the summary states how many events cannot be compared. The year-end rate bars now show each outcome's raw mid, so values and changes share one basis; when some outcomes are unquoted, distribution charts say they are not a complete distribution and no longer show a median.

item.title: Methodology change: The homepage “Biggest moves” lists usable events only, with
item.description: The homepage “Biggest moves” lists usable events only, with thin-book events on a separate line; while the system has run for under 7 days, collection coverage is labeled “since launch”; rule texts are no longer truncated.

item.title: Methodology change: Charts and tables now separate backfilled venue trade prices
item.description: Charts and tables now separate backfilled venue trade prices (dashed) from mids collected by the system (solid); resolved events are marked “Resolved” with the result; the public board checks the site for new data every 5 minutes.

item.title: Methodology change: All displayed numbers now round half up, so the text and the
item.description: All displayed numbers now round half up, so the text and the figures no longer differ by 0.1; cross-venue differences are computed from unrounded quotes.

item.title: Methodology change: The public board is now published automatically about every
item.description: The public board is now published automatically about every 15 minutes.

item.title: Methodology change: The thin-book flag is now recomputed daily from the median o
item.description: The thin-book flag is now recomputed daily from the median of the past 24 hours of live order books.
